svg.aria-label: The Demoverse weekly loop, drawn as 8-bit pixel art. Your company config (competitors, win rate, trends) and a target list of real ICP accounts seed the ledger at state/world.json. A deterministic TypeScript engine runs a weekly advance that opens and closes deals and emits one grounded prompt per touch point. An AI coding agent writes the prose. The engine then ingests, lints and reconciles it into Salesforce, Google Drive and Slack, and records the external IDs back on the ledger.
